description: This file contains Go source code implementing JSONPath parsing, traversal, setting, and deletion functions for handling JSON data structures within the Kubernetes project.

classes.name: jsonPathNode
classes.description: Represents a node in a JSONPath, either with an index or a field name.

classes.name: JSONPath
classes.description: A slice of jsonPathNode representing a JSONPath expression.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Converts a JSONPath to its string representation.

methods.name: jsonPaths
methods.description: Recursively generates all JSONPaths within a nested JSON structure.

methods.name: jsonIterSlice
methods.description: Iterates over a JSON array, generating JSONPaths for each element.

methods.name: JSONPathValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specified JSONPath within a JSON object.

methods.name: setJSONPath
methods.description: Sets a value at a specified JSONPath within a JSON object.

methods.name: setJSONPathSlice
methods.description: Helper function to set a value in a JSON array at a specified index.

methods.name: DeleteJSONPath
methods.description: Deletes a value at a specified JSONPath within a JSON object.

methods.name: deleteJSONPathSlice
methods.description: Helper function to delete a value in a JSON array at a specified index.
